pricing.seoDescription: See how {product} is scoped, what is included, what changes the estimate, and when payment starts.
pricing.title: A clear {product} scope before you pay
pricing.lead: There is no made-up package price. aiNOW first checks your real task, writes down what is included and excluded, and gives you one price to approve.

offers.title: One offer tied to your real task
offers.intro: The proposal names the result, access, integrations, approval points, timeline and ongoing costs. Anything outside it stays visible.

offer.name: {product} written scope
offer.summary: A product-specific proposal based on your workflow, required connections and approval rules.
offer.billing: Price fixed in the written proposal
offer.excluded1: Third-party fees, advertising spend and paid licences unless explicitly listed
offer.excluded2: New work added after the written scope is approved
offer.excluded3: Guaranteed business results that depend on the market, platforms or customer behaviour
offer.driver1: Number and complexity of the workflows or screens
offer.driver2: Required integrations, data access and migration
offer.driver3: Launch, training and ongoing support requirements
offer.eligibility1: A responsible product owner and a clear first use case
offer.eligibility2: Access to the systems and data needed for a safe test
offer.eligibility3: Written approval of the pilot boundary before real-world use

timeline.title: You know the decision before the invoice
timeline.s1Description: We confirm the business task, users, current process and the result that would count as useful.
timeline.s2Description: aiNOW lists the deliverables, integrations, approvals, exclusions, timeline and price.
timeline.s3Description: Work starts only after you approve the same written scope that the team will follow.
timeline.s4Description: The proposal states what you receive, who owns each access and what support continues after launch.

faq.title: What a buyer should know
faq.q1: Why is there no single public price for {product}?
faq.a1: The cost depends on the real workflow, integrations and launch boundary. aiNOW gives you a written price before work starts instead of advertising a number that does not match your task.
faq.q2: Do I pay before I know the full scope?
faq.a2: No. The proposal names the deliverables, exclusions, timeline and price first. Payment and work begin only after you approve it.
faq.a3: Third-party licences, hosting, advertising spend, store fees and other provider charges are separate unless the proposal explicitly includes them.
faq.q4: What happens if the task changes?
faq.a4: aiNOW explains the effect on price and timing before adding the new work. The approved scope does not silently expand.
faq.q5: Who owns the finished work and access?
faq.a5: Ownership, source access, accounts and handover are written into the proposal or contract before work begins.

privacy.seoDescription: How AI NOW LLC handles contact requests and product-project data submitted through {domain}.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This page explains what the public {domain} website receives and how product-project data is handled.

sections.controllerBody: AI NOW LLC (Georgia, ID 406549070) operates this product website. Privacy questions and rights requests can be sent to CONTACT@aiNOW.GE.
sections.publicSiteBody: If you submit the contact form, the website receives the information entered in that form, primarily your phone number. Hosting infrastructure may also create standard security logs. This landing page does not collect the operational data used inside a future product project.
sections.purposeBody: The contact information is used to answer your request, understand the requested service, protect the website and meet legal obligations. It is not sold.
sections.projectBody: If a project begins, the exact sources, fields, providers, access rights, retention, deletion and human approval rules are written into the proposal, contract or data-processing terms before operational data is connected.
sections.sharingBody: Information may be handled by hosting, communication or technical providers needed to answer the request or operate the agreed service. AI NOW LLC may also disclose information when Georgian law requires it. Product-specific providers are confirmed in the project scope.
sections.retentionBody: Contact and project records are kept only for the business relationship, security and legal periods that apply to them. You can request access, correction or deletion by writing to CONTACT@aiNOW.GE. A legal retention duty may limit deletion.
sections.rightsBody: You may ask what personal data AI NOW LLC holds about you, request correction or deletion, object where applicable, or contact the Personal Data Protection Service of Georgia. Send the request to CONTACT@aiNOW.GE.
sections.changesBody: Material changes are published on this page with a new updated date. The applicable project documents remain part of any active contract.
